text: The Patriots are navigating a critical defensive reshuffle heading into Jacksonville, as rookie linebacker Gabe Jacas—a second-round pick who's already delivered impact plays—takes on expanded responsibility in Week 3, though the secondary is getting healthier with cornerback Carlton Davis III set to return from injury. On the injury front, it's a mixed bag: while tight end Eli Raridon (thigh) and safety Craig Woodson (shoulder) are both questionable and made the trip, the team ruled out edge rushers Dre'Mont Jones (shoulder) and Quintayvious Hutchins (knee), the latter now on injured reserve, forcing the Patriots to elevate safety Mike Brown and defensive tackle Jeremiah Pharms Jr. from the practice squad for reinforcement. The Jaguars, still chasing redemption after their worst offensive showing in nearly a year, are sensing vulnerability in a Patriots team that continues to iron out organizational wrinkles—and speaking of wrinkles, New England's clock management in the second quarter has drawn scrutiny after two straight weeks of dubious late-halftime decisions that the team readily acknowledges need immediate correction.
